run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_wiki_brancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare wiki file branching
branch_wiki_files: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to create versioned SVN copies of documentation
update_links_in_branched_files: update internal wiki links in branched files so they point to versioned page names
drop_wiki_suffix: drop the .wiki suffix from a filename using the DropWikiSuffix utility function
